caseName: Richards v. United States District Court for the Southern District of Texas
caseNameFull: Richards, Governor of Texas v. United States District Court for the Southern District of Texas (Sheriff of Harris County, Real Parties in Interest)

opinions.text: Application for stay of a portion of the judgment of the United States District Court for the Southern District of Texas filed February 7, 1991, presented to Justice Scalia, and by him referred to the Court, denied, and the order heretofore entered by Justice Scalia on March 20, 1991, is vacated.
